title: security evidence (v1)
description: Outcome vocabulary for the adversarial security lane (microvm-security-tests, plan todo 31). Each artifact records one security domain's adversarial probes. A probe drives a real production security boundary (artifact path resolver, binary provenance gate, cgroup-v2 hierarchy, peer-credential auth, snapshot integrity/compatibility gate, constrained OCI importer, or scope-fidelity surface) against a hostile input and records the typed ErrorCode the boundary produced. These artifacts are deterministic (no /dev/kvm, root, or pinned binary required) and are NOT grep-only: every item is the structured rejection a real code path returned. This schema is a security-specific extension of evidence-deterministic.v1.json: it adds per-probe typed-error fields (expected_code/actual_code/trap) so a reviewer can see exactly which rejection each trap produced. `actual_code` is the literal string 'bypass' when the hostile operation unexpectedly succeeded.

class.description: Lane discriminator. Security probes are deterministic.

schema.description: Schema identifier embedded by the emitter.

domain.description: The security domain this artifact covers (e.g. path_security, binary_security, cgroup_security, auth_security, network_security, snapshot_security, oci_security, scope_fidelity, adversarial).

trap.description: The trap class exercised (e.g. path:symlink_escape, binary:dynamic_binary).

expected_code.description: The stable ErrorCode the boundary must produce to be secure.

actual_code.description: The stable ErrorCode actually produced, or the literal 'bypass' when the hostile operation succeeded.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the probe in milliseconds.

summary.description: Aggregate counts. total == items.length; pass + fail == total.
